about: C3b look development: the wreck's checkpoint, E out of the car by real input, a look at him; positions printed. NOIR_PORT=5343 node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/tail_out_look.json

steps.eval: (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase, c = G.camera.position; return JSON.stringify({ phase: C.phase, mode: G.controller.mode, eye: [c.x, c.y, c.z].map((v) => +v.toFixed(2)), man: C.manAt, his: [C.his.pos.x, C.his.pos.z].map((v) => +v.toFixed(2)), my: [C.my.pos.x, C.my.pos.z].map((v) => +v.toFixed(2)), yaw: +G.controller.yaw.toFixed(2), pitch: +G.controller.pitch.toFixed(2), fov: G.camera.fov, gy: G.controller.groundY, manPos: C.man && C.man.fig ? [C.man.fig.pos.x, C.man.fig.pos.z] : null, vis: C.man && C.man.fig && C.man.fig.object ? C.man.fig.object.visible : null }); })()
